Crypto market under pressure: Trump tariffs trigger correction

New 25% tariffs on steel and aluminum announced by Trump have pushed the crypto market cap down by 3%. Prices of Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, and Dogecoin have dropped sharply, with traders shifting focus to Bitcoin, https://t.co/9dcWUZuyRJ

DOGE Launches Major SEC Audit Under Musk's Leadership 

Led by Elon Musk @elonmusk  , DOGE @dogecoin has announced a large-scale review of SEC activities, urging the public to report any violations. This unprecedented move has sparked heated debates among political circles, https://t.co/cXorlh7gWM

SEC Delays Decision on XRP, Solana, Litecoin, and Dogecoin ETFs

The SEC @SECNetwork  has extended the review period for spot ETF applications for XRP, Solana, Litecoin, and Dogecoin. Experts see the delays as expected but remain optimistic about approval chances.
